_comment: PROPOSED BASELINE for bridging $RCLAW Solana <-> Base via Wormhole NTT. TESTNET/DRAFT. Ratify before any mainnet use — see docs/TOKEN_ROADMAP.md §9, §10.
_modeNote: hub-and-spoke LOCKS tokens on the Solana hub and mints a wrapped representation on Base. Chosen because token/ REVOKES mint authority after mint — burn-and-mint would require handing mint authority to an NTT-controlled PDA, which contradicts the fixed-supply/authorities-revoked guarantee in the roadmap (§2, §11).

spokes.token: <FILL after `ntt add-chain BaseSepolia` deploys the wrapped token>

transfer._automaticNote: false = manual relaying: the script fetches the VAA and submits the redeem on the destination chain. true requires a relayer to be configured for the route.

limits._comment: NTT rate limits are set on-chain via the ntt CLI (outbound/inbound per 24h). Mirror the intended values here for review.
